_doc: File-level vocab-extension queue. vocab_lint --fix appends entries here when it encounters a genuinely new term it cannot mechanically rewrite. Independent of audit rows so review-loop / physics-loop entries are not dropped when no audit row exists yet. See docs/repo/VOCABULARY_HYGIENE_DESIGN.md.

_entry_shape.recorded_by: string (loop identifier: audit-loop / review-loop / physics-loop / etc.)

_cadence: Weekly batch OR 10+ queued entries, whichever comes first. The nightly audit cron at 0 6 * * * UTC can be extended with a 'vocab-extension-queue summary' step that posts the current queue as a single comment or issue; a human reviewer or scheduled agent then batches the accepted terms into one PR against docs/repo/controlled_vocabulary.yaml.
_backpressure: If the queue exceeds 50 entries, audit-loop and review-loop emit prose_status: queue_backpressure_exceeded instead of needs_human_vocab_decision so the absence of review is visible on every new row.
